title: [EP-5715ce] Offline Mode for the Field Inspections App
body:
Field inspectors use the mobile app at construction sites and rural facilities where signal is unreliable. When the connection drops, the app shows a spinner and inspectors lose notes and photos. Inspectors fall back to paper and re-type reports later.

### Stories
- [ ] [ST-c3081d] Download assigned inspections for offline use before leaving coverage
- [ ] [ST-e3f064] Fill in checklists, add notes and capture photos while offline
- [ ] [ST-5199d9] Sync queued changes to the server automatically in the background
- [ ] [ST-327858] Sync must resume after interruption without duplicating photos
- [ ] [ST-bc70e9] Detect the conflict and let the inspector choose which version of each...
- [ ] [ST-7d05f0] Show a clear offline indicator and the number of changes waiting to sync
- [ ] [ST-0d2dcf] Pre-fetch map tiles for assigned sites

title: [ST-c3081d] Download assigned inspections for offline use before leaving coverage
body:
As a field inspector, I want to download assigned inspections for offline use before leaving coverage, so that it supports the goal "Inspectors can complete a full inspection with no connectivity".

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] **Given** a field inspector, **when** the field inspector downloads assigned inspections for offline use before leaving coverage, **then** the download includes checklists, prior findings and site documents

### Traceability
- REQ-c3081d (examples/mobile-offline-mode.md:27): Inspectors must be able to download assigned inspections for offline use before leaving coverage.

### Estimate
3 points. base 1; +2 distributed-state complexity (offline) = score 3 -> 3 pts

Epic: EP-5715ce

title: [ST-e3f064] Fill in checklists, add notes and capture photos while offline
body:
As a field inspector, I want to fill in checklists, add notes and capture photos while offline, so that it supports the goal "Inspectors can complete a full inspection with no connectivity".

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] **Given** a field inspector, **when** the field inspector fills in checklists, add notes and capture photos while offline, **then** all offline changes are stored locally and encrypted at rest

### Traceability
- REQ-e3f064 (examples/mobile-offline-mode.md:30): The app must let inspectors fill in checklists, add notes and capture photos while offline.

### Estimate
5 points. base 1; +2 distributed-state complexity (offline); +1 security or compliance (encrypted) = score 4 -> 5 pts

Epic: EP-5715ce

title: [ST-5199d9] Sync queued changes to the server automatically in the background
body:
As a field inspector, I want the system to sync queued changes to the server automatically in the background, so that it supports the goal "Inspectors can complete a full inspection with no connectivity".

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] **Given** a field inspector, **when** connectivity returns, **then** the app must sync queued changes to the server automatically in the background

### Traceability
- REQ-5199d9 (examples/mobile-offline-mode.md:33): When connectivity returns, the app must sync queued changes to the server automatically in the background.

### Estimate
3 points. base 1; +2 distributed-state complexity (sync, queued, background) = score 3 -> 3 pts

Epic: EP-5715ce

title: [ST-bc70e9] Detect the conflict and let the inspector choose which version of each...
body:
As a field inspector, I want the system to detect the conflict and let the inspector choose which version of each conflicting field to keep, so that it supports the goal "Inspectors can complete a full inspection with no connectivity".

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] **Given** a field inspector, **when** the same inspection was edited on the server while the inspector was offline, **then** the app must detect the conflict and let the inspector choose which version of each conflicting field to keep

### Traceability
- REQ-bc70e9 (examples/mobile-offline-mode.md:36): If the same inspection was edited on the server while the inspector was offline, the app must detect the conflict and let the inspector choose which version of each conflicting field to keep.

### Estimate
3 points. base 1; +2 distributed-state complexity (offline, conflict, conflicting) = score 3 -> 3 pts

Epic: EP-5715ce
